'''Rothana''' was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Rothana system/Legends|Rothana system]] located in [[Quiberon sector/Legends|Quiberon sector]], near the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], most famous for being the headquarters of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] and the source of military materiel for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
A snowy world with arctic terrain in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]], Rothana's wildlife was adapted to the freezing conditions. The Rothanian [[Arctic horny whelmer/Legends|arctic horny whelmer]] had a wide, squatting, sturdy stance that was mimicked in the design of the [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|RHE]] [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]].<ref name="ICS" />

As the headquarters of [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], the planet's economy was almost entirely based around shipbuilding and developing military vehicles. Rothana was surrounded by a vast honeycomb of orbital [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and [[Drydock/Legends|drydocks]] for KDY's secret constructions. The planet was protected by a formidable [[KDY corporate-security starfleet/Legends|KDY corporate-security starfleet]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
Rothana was discovered in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] by [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] in [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]]. Its location was then sold to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], which dispatched the noted engineer [[Quiberon Kuat]] to the [[Rothana system/Legends|Rothana system]] with thousands of workers and a fleet of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. In his lifetime, Kuat used Rothana's great mineral wealth to create a dense network of [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], mines and factories that became [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]], a subsidiary of KDY.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Located far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and isolated from corporate espionage, Rothana became KDY's primary site for pursuing secret projects. It was accessible only by a convoluted network of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the locations of which were issued to KDY personnel on a strictly need-to-know basis: KDY ships did not even receive Rothana's coordinates. Instead they jumped to one of several points beyond [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]], the junction of the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]]. There they downloaded encrypted hyperspace coordinates and an [[Identify Friend/Foe transponder|IFF]] signal from an RHE [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace beacon]]. Broadcasting the signal then temporarily deactivated the numerous [[mass-shadow mine]]s placed along the [[Rothana Route]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Such a convoluted security system caused tragedy in [[311 BBY]], when the star [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] carrying [[Ursela Kuat]], KDY's principal director, was destroyed on the [[Rothana Route]]. This sparked the [[Kuati Succession Crisis]], and only decades later did it come to light that Kuat had been killed by rivals on the KDY directorate.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Rothana became surrounded by a vast network of shipyards. Due to its close proximity to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Rothana was chosen by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] to manufacture the vehicles and vessels of the clone army they were growing for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the request of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], KDY principal director [[Onara Kuat]] received an immense, anonymous order to create a massive force of new military vehicles. In addition to the vast amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] KDY received in instalments for the order, it was also given billions more to blaze a new hyperlane from Rothana to Kamino, the [[Quiberon Line]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Over the next nine years, [[Project Icefang/Legends|Project Icefang]] saw the development of thousands of new military vehicles for the clone army. Ships traveled back and forth along the [[Quiberon Line]] for testing and training on Kamino. A handful of field tests were conducted elsewhere, but were so few that sightings of the new vehicles were dismissed as fantasies.<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rothana continued to produce equipment for the GAR and withstood repeated Separatist plots to discover its location. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Rothana was host to several advanced Imperial ship-constructions, including the automated [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''. Rothana's location was mostly declassified, and the region around it became the [[Quiberon sector/Legends|Quiberon sector]], though access remained heavily restricted and the planet strongly guarded.<ref name="TEGtW" /> The planet became an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]], but was abandoned by the Empire once the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] won the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] believed Rothana would join with the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellians]] purely to observe due to their shipbuilding rivalry.<ref name="bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
Rothana's isolation created an insular culture among the Rothanians, who developed an elaborate system of etiquette far too complicated for outsiders to mimic. This provided an additional layer of security against corporate espionage. The Rothanians were considered insular and strange even by [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] standards.<ref name="TEGtW" /><ref name="ICS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Curtis Saxton]] mentioned in an interview with [[TheForce.net]] that Rothana was named in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' after an intervention from [[George Lucas]].<ref name="TheForce">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/jedicouncil/interview/saxton.asp|text=A Chat with Curtis Saxton|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archivedate=20210303053505}}</ref>
